name: Haruka Nakagawa
bio: Writes about records the way people write about weather — constantly, and with feeling.

notes.note: Shoegaze and dream pop that still hisses. I kept the ones where the tape is part of the song, not a filter on top of it.
Tokyo after the last train. Ren Ishii and Redshift are from here; the rest is what I hear in the taxi home.
